test_cases.test_case: Click Activity / Resource link when target resource is missing or unpublished
preconditions: User is on the Course page and the Activities list contains at least one item whose target resource is missing or unpublished
steps: 1. Click the Activity / Resource name link for the activity whose target is missing/unpublished
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation to the activity is blocked; an error indicator is shown. Specifically, the Course page displays an inline error banner or error page indicating the resource is unavailable (e.g. 'Resource not found' / 'This activity is unavailable'), the Activity / Resource content is not opened, and the Course page remains unchanged (no navigation away from the Course page).

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Collapse all' when the course has zero sections
preconditions: User is on the Course page for a course that contains zero sections (Sections repeating group is empty)
steps: 1. Attempt to locate the 'Collapse all' link at the top right of the Course page
2. If the 'Collapse all' link is visible and enabled, click the 'Collapse all' link
test_cases.expected_result: UI prevents a meaningless action: the 'Collapse all' link is either not visible or is disabled when there are no sections. If the link is visible and clicked, nothing changes on the page (no sections are collapsed) and no JavaScript error is shown; the page remains in the same state with no sections listed.

modules.module: Course Edit Mode and Activity Chooser

test_cases.test_case: Enable Edit Mode reveals authoring controls and add buttons
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit Mode' checkbox on the Course page
test_cases.expected_result: enables authoring inline controls and add buttons

test_cases.test_case: Inline rename a section while Edit Mode is enabled
steps: 1. Locate a section and click its inline rename control
2. Enter <new section name> into the inline rename field
3. Confirm/save the inline rename
test_cases.expected_result: Section heading displays '<new section name>'

test_cases.test_case: Duplicate a section from the section three-dot menu
preconditions: A section exists with at least one activity
steps: 1. Click the section's three-dot menu to open Section Menu
2. Click 'Duplicate' in the Section Menu
test_cases.expected_result: A new section row appears immediately below the original section with the same title as the original section

test_cases.test_case: Hide a section via the section menu
steps: 1. Click the section's three-dot menu to open Section Menu
2. Click 'Hide' in the Section Menu
test_cases.expected_result: The section shows a visible hidden indicator (for example a 'Hidden' badge or visually dimmed styling) indicating the section is hidden

test_cases.test_case: Insert a nested subsection using '+ Add a subsection' button
steps: 1. Click '+ Add a subsection' inside the target section
test_cases.expected_result: A nested subsection entry is inserted under the section and is visible in the section outline

test_cases.test_case: Inline rename an activity row
preconditions: An activity row exists in a section
steps: 1. Click the activity row's Inline Rename action
2. Enter <new activity name> into the Inline Rename field
3. Confirm/save the inline rename
test_cases.expected_result: Activity row displays '<new activity name>' as its title

test_cases.test_case: Open activity settings from an activity-level menu
steps: 1. Click the activity's three-dot Activity Menu on the activity row
2. Click 'Edit settings' from the Activity Menu
test_cases.expected_result: opens activity settings editor for the selected activity

test_cases.test_case: Duplicate multiple selected activities using the Bulk Actions toolbar
preconditions: Two or more activity rows exist in a section
steps: 1. Select multiple activity rows using the table checkboxes
2. Confirm the Bulk Actions toolbar appears
3. Click 'Duplicate selected' in the Bulk Actions toolbar
test_cases.expected_result: Duplicate rows appear in the Activities table matching the titles of the selected activities, visible adjacent to the original rows

test_cases.test_case: Open Activity Chooser and add a selected tile (opens creation form)
steps: 1. Click '+ Add an activity or resource' inside a section to open the Activity Chooser modal
2. In the Activity Chooser modal, select the 'Assignment' tile
3. Click the 'Add' button in the Activity Chooser modal
test_cases.expected_result: opens creation form for selected activity/resource

test_cases.test_case: Mark an Activity Chooser tile as favorite using the star toggle
steps: 1. Click '+ Add an activity or resource' to open the Activity Chooser modal
2. Click the Star / Favorite toggle on the <selected tile> within the Activity Chooser
test_cases.expected_result: The <selected tile> displays the favorite/star state (star icon shown as selected) in the Activity Chooser

test_cases.test_case: Section inline rename — required text field left blank
preconditions: User is on the Course page
steps: 1. Click the inline rename control for a section to open the Section Inline Rename input
2. Leave the Section Inline Rename input blank
3. Click Save (or press Enter) to submit the rename
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Section Inline Rename field indicating it is required; the save is blocked and the section title remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Activity Chooser — click Add without selecting a tile (dialog precondition failure)
preconditions: User is on the Course page
Activity Chooser modal is opened via '+ Add an activity or resource'
steps: 1. In the Activity Chooser modal, do not select any activity/resource tile
2. Click the Add button in the Activity Chooser modal
test_cases.expected_result: Activity Chooser modal remains open; submission is blocked; an inline validation indicator appears on the tile selection area stating a tile must be selected (tile selection highlighted or an inline error message is shown); no creation form opens

test_cases.test_case: Bulk action attempted when no rows are selected (precondition not met)
preconditions: User is on the Course page
steps: 1. Ensure no activity rows are selected
2. Look for the Bulk Actions toolbar and the 'Delete selected' action
test_cases.expected_result: Bulk Actions toolbar is not visible and the 'Delete selected' action is not present when no rows are selected; attempt to invoke the bulk delete action is not possible (no button to click) and no deletion occurs

test_cases.test_case: Add controls not accessible when Edit Mode is disabled (visible_when violation)
preconditions: User is on the Course page
steps: 1. On a section, look for the '+ Add an activity or resource' button
2. Attempt to click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button if it is visible
test_cases.expected_result: The '+ Add an activity or resource' button is not present while Edit Mode is disabled; the Activity Chooser cannot be opened and no modal appears

test_cases.test_case: Section and activity action menus are not available when Edit Mode is disabled
preconditions: User is on the Course page
steps: 1. Inspect a section row for the section-level three-dot menu (Section_Menu)
2. Inspect an activity row for the activity-level three-dot menu (Activity Menu / row actions)
test_cases.expected_result: Section-level and activity-level action menu controls are not visible when Edit Mode is disabled; user cannot open edit/duplicate/hide/delete/move actions from the UI

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all visible required authoring fields left empty (multiple required fields blank)
preconditions: User is on the Course page
steps: 1. Open inline rename for a section and leave the Section Inline Rename input blank
2. Save the section rename
3. Open inline rename for an activity row (New_Name) and leave the New_Name input blank
4. Save the activity inline rename
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on both the Section Inline Rename and the activity New_Name fields indicating they are required; both saves are blocked and neither the section title nor the activity name is changed

test_cases.test_case: Activity Chooser: Add with exactly one tile selected succeeds
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button on a section
2. Wait for the Activity Chooser modal to open
3. Select exactly one Activity Tile (choose any single tile)
4. Click the 'Add' button in the Activity Chooser modal
test_cases.expected_result: succeeds: Creation form for the selected activity/resource opens and the Activity Chooser modal closes; the creation form for that tile is visible.

test_cases.test_case: Activity Chooser: clicking Add with zero tiles selected is blocked
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button on a section
2. Wait for the Activity Chooser modal to open
3. Ensure no Activity Tile is selected
4. Click the 'Add' button in the Activity Chooser modal
test_cases.expected_result: is blocked / error shown: The Add action is blocked; a visible validation indicator appears in the modal notifying the user that a tile must be selected (Add does not open a creation form).

test_cases.test_case: Bulk actions toolbar visibility boundary between one and two selections
preconditions: A section contains at least two activities
steps: 1. Select exactly one activity row in a section's activities table
2. Observe whether the Bulk Actions Toolbar is visible
3. Select a second activity row (so two rows are selected)
4. Observe whether the Bulk Actions Toolbar is visible
test_cases.expected_result: boundary behavior: After step 1 the Bulk Actions Toolbar does not appear (is blocked from appearing with only one selection); after step 3 the Bulk Actions Toolbar appears and bulk actions become available (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Activity Chooser: rapid double-click Add after selecting a tile should not open duplicate creation forms
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button on a section
2. Wait for the Activity Chooser modal to open
3. Select one Activity Tile
4. Click the 'Add' button
5. Immediately click the 'Add' button again (second click while first action is processing)
test_cases.expected_result: is blocked / error shown for duplicate attempt: Only one creation form is opened for the selected tile; the second click does not open a second creation form (the second submission attempt is blocked and the UI remains on the single creation form).

test_cases.test_case: Section Inline Rename rejects whitespace-only input when Edit Mode is enabled
steps: 1. In a section row, activate the Section Inline Rename control
2. Enter a name consisting only of whitespace characters into the rename field
3. Commit the inline rename (press Enter or click the inline save control)
test_cases.expected_result: is blocked / error shown: The inline rename is not accepted; the Section Inline Rename field displays a visible required/validation error indicating the name cannot be blank while Edit Mode is enabled.

test_cases.test_case: Activity inline rename accepts special characters and emoji
preconditions: At least one activity exists in a section
steps: 1. In an activity row, invoke the Inline Rename action
2. Enter a string containing special characters and emoji into the New_Name field
3. Commit the inline rename (press Enter or click the inline save control)
test_cases.expected_result: succeeds: The inline rename is accepted; the activity row displays the entered special characters/emoji in the activity name field.

test_cases.test_case: Toggling Edit Mode off while Activity Chooser is open closes the chooser and hides inline controls
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button on a section
2. Wait for the Activity Chooser modal to open
3. Click the Edit Mode toggle to disable Edit Mode
test_cases.expected_result: succeeds: The Activity Chooser modal closes immediately and inline authoring controls are hidden on the Course page (Edit Mode UI elements are removed).

test_cases.test_case: Activity Chooser search with a very long/special-character string returns no matches and prevents Add
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add an activity or resource' button on a section
2. Wait for the Activity Chooser modal to open
3. Enter a very long search string containing special characters and emoji into the Chooser Search field
4. Observe the Activity Tiles area and the Add button state
test_cases.expected_result: is blocked / error shown: The chooser shows no matching tiles (a visible 'no results' state) and the Add button remains disabled or blocked (user cannot add until a tile is selected).

test_cases.test_case: Upload file exactly at site maximum upload size succeeds
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> User_Picture -> New_Picture_Upload has site-defined upload constraints
steps: 1. Expand the User_Picture section (or click Expand all)
2. Use the New_Picture_Upload control to select a file whose size is exactly the site-defined maximum upload size
3. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: Upload succeeds and Update profile submits successfully; the profile page refreshes and the new picture is displayed on the refreshed profile page

test_cases.test_case: Upload file one byte over site maximum is blocked with visible error
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> User_Picture -> New_Picture_Upload validates upload constraints
steps: 1. Expand the User_Picture section (or click Expand all)
2. Use the New_Picture_Upload control to select a file whose size is exactly one byte larger than the site-defined maximum upload size
3. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: Update is blocked; an inline error message appears adjacent to New_Picture_Upload indicating the file exceeds the site-defined upload size constraint and the profile is not saved

test_cases.test_case: Very long Description (200+ characters) via rich text editor
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> General -> Description is a rich text field
steps: 1. Expand the General section (or click Expand all)
2. Focus the Description rich text editor
3. Enter a very long text string (200+ characters) into Description
4. Fill required fields: enter a valid First_Name
5. Enter a valid Last_Name
6. Enter a valid Email_Address
7. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: If the site accepts 200+ characters, Update profile succeeds and the refreshed profile page displays the full entered Description as saved; if the site enforces a shorter Description limit, Update profile is blocked or an inline notice appears explaining truncation and the Description shown on the profile is truncated with a visible indicator

test_cases.test_case: Leading and trailing whitespace in First_Name is trimmed on save
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> General -> First_Name is required
steps: 1. Expand the General section (or click Expand all)
2. Enter a First_Name value with leading and trailing whitespace into First_Name
3. Enter a valid Last_Name
4. Enter a valid Email_Address
5. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: Update profile succeeds and the refreshed profile page displays the First_Name value with leading/trailing whitespace removed (trimmed) in the profile detail view

test_cases.test_case: Internationalized / non-ASCII characters in Email_Address (IDN/Unicode) handled
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> General -> Email_Address is of type email and required
steps: 1. Expand the General section (or click Expand all)
2. Enter an Email_Address that contains internationalized/non-ASCII characters (Unicode) into Email_Address
3. Enter a valid First_Name
4. Enter a valid Last_Name
5. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: If the platform supports internationalized email addresses, Update profile succeeds and the refreshed profile page shows the saved Unicode email; if the platform does not support it, Update profile is blocked and an inline error appears next to Email_Address explaining invalid email format

test_cases.test_case: Extremely long single tag entered into Interests_Tags
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> Interests -> Interests_Tags is a tag-based input allowing multiple tags
steps: 1. Expand the Interests section (or click Expand all)
2. Enter a single tag whose length is very large (200+ characters) into Interests_Tags and commit the tag
3. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: If the tag input accepts very long tags, Update profile succeeds and the refreshed profile page displays the full long tag in Interests; if the site enforces a maximum tag length, the tag is truncated or an inline error is shown next to Interests_Tags and Update profile is blocked

test_cases.test_case: Add alternative names then remove all entries and submit
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> Additional_Names -> Alternative_Names is a repeating_group and is optional
steps: 1. Expand the Additional_Names section (or click Expand all)
2. Add an item to Alternative_Names (create one alternative name entry)
3. Add another item to Alternative_Names (create a second alternative name entry)
4. Remove the first alternative name entry
5. Remove the second alternative name entry so no Alternative_Names remain
6. Click the Update profile button
test_cases.expected_result: Update profile succeeds (Alternative_Names is optional) and the refreshed profile page shows no alternative names; no validation error is shown for having zero entries in the repeating group

test_cases.test_case: Rapid resubmission / browser back after successful Update profile does not create duplicate artifacts
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit Profile page
AST trace: Edit_Profile_Form -> submit_actions on success refreshes the profile page
steps: 1. Fill required fields: enter a valid First_Name
2. Enter a valid Last_Name
3. Enter a valid Email_Address
4. Click the Update profile button
5. Wait for the profile page to refresh (success state shown)
6. Press the browser Back button to return to the Edit Profile form
7. Click the Update profile button again without changing any fields
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission does not create duplicate artifacts or unintended side effects; the profile remains at the state produced by the first successful update and no extra records or duplicate entries appear; any UI confirmation shown corresponds to a harmless update (no duplication)
